messages.author: 6b3b475e6af83898
messages.subject: R 3.1 issue?
parts:
I just upgraded from R 3.0.3 to 3.1.0, and now when I compile models in rstan, they consistently fail with "Error in .Call(Module__functions_names, xp) : negative length vectors are not allowed”

AFAICT, this is an error being emitted by R, but I can’t fathom why. Has anyone else seen this, or is it a bug in my installation? I tried removing and reinstalling rstan.

Thanks,
Josh

messages.author: 20758fda448fdbda
messages.subject: Re: R 3.1 issue?
parts:
Which operation system are you on? On Windows, I've found that at times you just have to uninstall and reinstall Rstan. When you  uninstall rstan, make sure to delete the rstan subdirectory in the library folder. You also may wish to delete the .R file in your home directory so that if there were any updates to Makevars, Rstan picks them up.

For what it's worth, I have Rstan running just fine under R-3.1.0.

Avi
